name: Nozzlurm
look: a grey velvet worm on stubby legs with orange rings across its back, a blue neck and belly, an orange tail curling up, a grey head under an orange hood, red eye discs with a white slit and a long cyan nozzle snout
entry: It aims its long nozzle like a hose and sprays jets of water or glue with pinpoint accuracy. A whole swarm can glue a tree's worth of Bug Pokémon in place before they know they have been seen.
how: Wild: uncommon in jungles, swamps and bamboo forests.
Evolves into Onychydra at level 40, learning Dragon Pulse.
